title: Identify European Soil indirect records
changes: Authenticate five observed eight-byte records, compatible original reader and initializer links, and existing literal and adjacent source owners.
validation: Wine disassemblies u03116_g, 8lucbl5h and ezcwvq_7 plus protected plan e293-soil-indirect-records-source-plan-tcv9a6zh verify 40 unowned source bytes including 35 sampled bytes.
limitations: Static source links do not establish the actual ancestry of the sampled reads; arbitrary guest indices, neighboring bytes, runtime ownership, other callers and scenes remain open.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance comparison was performed.
